name: Transco Leidy East Expansion
researcher_notes: Not matched to an existing row: parent P0271 is a system row and no Leidy East row exists (Leidy South P2551 is a different project). The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 238, lists Transco Leidy East Expansion as a completed expansion, FERC docket CP01-389, in service June 2002, states PA, NJ and NY, 31 mi of new pipe, 42 in, 126 MMcf/d added, cost 128 (millions of dollars). 31 mi is above the 25 km rule. Only one source (EIA, one origin). The FERC order for CP01-389 was not read because the web search tool hit a session limit, so the segment may be a loop that overlaps the parent row and the exact start and end points are not confirmed (NJ is listed as a state, only PA and NY are staged). Pair with the FERC order when it can be read. Tier medium. No route researched. Proposal year 2001 inferred from the docket number, not stated by EIA.
